verdict.rationale: Typesense documents its own guides for running tests in isolated instances, via Testcontainers and GitHub Actions. Its open-source engine can be run locally or on any server, so a separate test instance can be spun up apart from production data. That is real isolation, not a dry-run mode, but it rests on standing up separate deployments rather than a dedicated sandbox or test-mode feature. Missing for 10: a first-party sandbox or test environment (e.g., a Cloud sandbox cluster or test-mode keys), documented data-isolation guarantees for agents, depth beyond section headings in the testing docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
